query: 2026년 8월 해외 CS 국가별 환불 건수와 USD 환불액, 원화 미환산 건수 알려줘
sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(country_name, ''), '국가 미상') AS country_name,
  COUNT(*) AS refund_count,
  SUM(refund_amount_usd) AS total_refund_amount_usd,
  COUNTIF(refund_amount_krw IS NULL) AS uncalculated_krw_count
FROM `skin1004-319714.cs_dashboard.overseas_cs_refunds`
WHERE DATE(refund_created_at, 'Asia/Seoul') BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
GROUP BY country_name
ORDER BY refund_count DESC
LIMIT 1000
